summary: npm-wold postinstall performs remote-controlled dispatch of arbitrary globals
details: The package's postinstall script (`node dist/config.js`) fetches JSON from https://my-api.trade-api.workers.dev?id=4 and executes `globalThis[data.success](data.id)`, invoking a global function whose name and argument are both chosen by the remote endpoint. This gives the endpoint operator arbitrary code execution on any host running `npm install npm-wold`, since the invoked sink is not statically visible in the shipped code and can pivot into eval-equivalent primitives selected server-side. The advertised purpose (a flatten/unflatten helper) does not require any install-time network fetch or dynamic global dispatch.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
